minecraft:extinguish_light.name: Snuffed Light
minecraft:extinguish_light.description: Snuffs a nearby candle, torch or lantern in place.

minecraft:candles_out.name: Candles Out
minecraft:candles_out.description: Every lit candle within range goes out at once.

minecraft:torch_chain.name: Torch Chain
minecraft:torch_chain.description: Up to eight torches go dark one after another, the nearest to the player last.

minecraft:lantern_flicker.name: Lantern Flicker
minecraft:lantern_flicker.description: A lantern flickers off and on three times without leaving its mount.

minecraft:lamp_off.name: Lamp Off
minecraft:lamp_off.description: A lit redstone lamp switches off for a second, then comes back if still powered.

minecraft:campfire_out.name: Campfire Out
minecraft:campfire_out.description: A lit campfire is snuffed out.

minecraft:furnace_dies.name: Dying Furnace
minecraft:furnace_dies.description: A burning furnace goes cold and its fuel is taken out for five seconds, then returned.

minecraft:dimming.name: Dimming
minecraft:dimming.description: The light slowly drains out of the world and then returns. Nothing in the world changes; only the player sees it.

minecraft:candles_light.name: Candle Lights Itself
minecraft:candles_light.description: An unlit candle nearby lights on its own.

minecraft:new_face.name: New Face
minecraft:new_face.description: A jack o'lantern slowly turns to face another way.

minecraft:blackout.name: Blackout
minecraft:blackout.description: Lights nearby go out and break, and a moment later a zombie or skeleton appears close by and attacks.

minecraft:burning_hand.name: Burning Hand
minecraft:burning_hand.description: The torch or lantern held in the main hand is dropped as if it burned.

minecraft:door.name: Door
minecraft:door.description: A wooden door opens by itself, or an open one slams shut.

minecraft:trapdoor.name: Trapdoor
minecraft:trapdoor.description: A wooden trapdoor flips with a slam.

minecraft:fence_gate.name: Fence Gate
minecraft:fence_gate.description: A fence gate swings open or shut.

minecraft:pressure_plate.name: Pressure Plate
minecraft:pressure_plate.description: A pressure plate triggers for a second with nothing on it.

minecraft:iron_door.name: Iron Door
minecraft:iron_door.description: An iron door opens or shuts without any redstone.

minecraft:breathing_door.name: Breathing Door
minecraft:breathing_door.description: A door opens and closes once a second, six times, and ends as it began.

minecraft:chest_lid.name: Chest Lid
minecraft:chest_lid.description: A chest lid opens and closes with its sound; the contents stay untouched.

minecraft:barrel_opens.name: Barrel Opens
minecraft:barrel_opens.description: A closed barrel opens for a moment, then shuts again.

minecraft:jukebox_pop.name: Jukebox Pop
minecraft:jukebox_pop.description: A playing jukebox cuts its music and spits the disc out.

minecraft:locked_door.name: Locked Door
minecraft:locked_door.description: A door slams shut with a thud and cannot be opened for ten seconds.

minecraft:open_house.name: Open House
minecraft:open_house.description: At night, every closed wooden door nearby swings open.

minecraft:echo.name: Echo
minecraft:echo.description: The last sound the player made, such as a step, a splash or a bite, is played again three seconds later from the place it was made.

minecraft:footsteps.name: Footsteps
minecraft:footsteps.description: A step sounds two blocks behind the player.

minecraft:creeper_hiss.name: Creeper Hiss
minecraft:creeper_hiss.description: A creeper fuse hisses close by, with no creeper in sight.

minecraft:three_knocks.name: Three Knocks
minecraft:three_knocks.description: Three knocks on the nearest wooden door, or from nowhere if there is none.

minecraft:crying_child.name: Crying Child
minecraft:crying_child.description: A high-pitched villager cry somewhere nearby.

minecraft:block_breaking.name: Block Breaking
minecraft:block_breaking.description: Stone, wood, glass or gravel breaks nearby, but nothing is broken.

minecraft:enderman_hiss.name: Enderman Hiss
minecraft:enderman_hiss.description: The sound of an enderman being stared at.

minecraft:chest_opens.name: Chest Opens
minecraft:chest_opens.description: A chest opens somewhere close by.

minecraft:breathing.name: Breathing
minecraft:breathing.description: Five breaths one block from the player, each louder than the last.

minecraft:distant_bell.name: Distant Bell
minecraft:distant_bell.description: A loud bell rings from about forty blocks away.

minecraft:phantom_jukebox.name: Phantom Jukebox
minecraft:phantom_jukebox.description: Music disc 11 plays from a spot nearby, with no jukebox there.

minecraft:music_cut.name: Music Cut
minecraft:music_cut.description: The background music stops and resumes on its usual schedule.

minecraft:whisper.name: Whisper
minecraft:whisper.description: A chat line from "???" with the player's own name, visible only to them.

minecraft:blindness.name: Blindness
minecraft:blindness.description: Blindness for six seconds, with a low cave sound.

minecraft:fatigue.name: Fatigue
minecraft:fatigue.description: Mining fatigue II for ten seconds.

minecraft:hunger_pang.name: Hunger Pang
minecraft:hunger_pang.description: Takes three food points, if the player has more than three bars.

minecraft:poison.name: Poison
minecraft:poison.description: Poison for five seconds; it cannot kill.

minecraft:levitation.name: Levitation
minecraft:levitation.description: Levitation for two seconds, then the fall.

minecraft:frostbite.name: Frostbite
minecraft:frostbite.description: The player freezes as in powder snow for about three seconds.

minecraft:cold_touch.name: Cold Touch
minecraft:cold_touch.description: One or two hearts of magic damage with a freezing sound; never lethal.

minecraft:trip.name: Trip
minecraft:trip.description: The player stops dead for a second.

minecraft:scorch.name: Scorch
minecraft:scorch.description: The player is set on fire for a second.

minecraft:wrath.name: Wrath
minecraft:wrath.description: Two to three and a half hearts of magic damage; never lethal.

minecraft:snatch.name: Snatch
minecraft:snatch.description: The item in the main hand is thrown about five blocks away.

minecraft:suffocation.name: Suffocation
minecraft:suffocation.description: A heartbeat, then the air bar drains and the player takes damage. Stops in light, in water, at three hearts or after fifteen seconds.

minecraft:shove.name: Shove
minecraft:shove.description: At the edge of a drop, the player is pushed toward it.

minecraft:toss.name: Toss
minecraft:toss.description: The player is thrown about five blocks straight up.

minecraft:thunder_knocks.name: Thunder Knocks
minecraft:thunder_knocks.description: Three knocks, then a bolt strikes nearby; a second hits the player if they have barely moved.

minecraft:shadow.name: Shadow
minecraft:shadow.description: A dark figure appears far off. It stands still while the player looks at it and walks closer when the player looks away. A touch hurts, down to three hearts at worst. It leaves after a minute.

minecraft:double.name: Double
minecraft:double.description: A figure with the player's own skin and gear appears and runs at them, hitting hard. It cannot be hurt, never takes the player below three hearts, and leaves after half a minute or four hits.

minecraft:edge_figure.name: Edge Figure
minecraft:edge_figure.description: A figure that looks like the player stands at the edge of their vision. It is gone as soon as the player looks straight at it.

minecraft:fog_silhouette.name: Fog Silhouette
minecraft:fog_silhouette.description: In rain or at night under open sky, a pale figure stands far away in the fog. It vanishes when the player comes close.

minecraft:distant_player.name: Distant Player
minecraft:distant_player.description: Another player in a default skin stands far away and keeps looking at the player. It vanishes when the player comes close.

minecraft:distant_walker.name: Distant Walker
minecraft:distant_walker.description: Another player in a default skin walks or runs past far away, across the player's view, jumping up steps and going round what is in its way. It vanishes when the player comes close, when there is no way on, or after a while.

minecraft:nametag.name: Nametag
minecraft:nametag.description: A player's nameplate floats with nobody under it: a few blocks under the floor, seen through it, or far off. Gone after a while.

minecraft:pillar.name: Pillar
minecraft:pillar.description: Another player in a default skin pillars up on cobblestone some way off: eyes on its feet, a jump, a block under it, a swing of the arm. Gone at the top or when approached; the pillar goes later.

minecraft:harvest.name: Harvest
minecraft:harvest.description: Another player in a default skin stands at the edge of the player's field and harvests the ripe crops within reach, with nothing dropped. They grow back later.

minecraft:the_call.name: The Call
minecraft:the_call.description: At night, a voice draws the player along the ground toward nearby lava or a drop into the void, a little at a time. Walking away breaks it. It never takes the player below three hearts by itself.

minecraft:undertow.name: Undertow
minecraft:undertow.description: While the player swims, something pulls them down every tenth of a second. It ends when they leave the water, at 3 hearts, or after 10 s.

minecraft:water_call.name: Water Call
minecraft:water_call.description: The player on land is drawn along the ground toward the nearest water within 12 blocks.

minecraft:drowned_fish.name: Drowned Fish
minecraft:drowned_fish.description: Squid and fish near the player die, in a puff of ink.

minecraft:broken_boat.name: Broken Boat
minecraft:broken_boat.description: An empty boat nearby comes apart.

minecraft:embrace.name: Embrace
minecraft:embrace.description: Growing damage every second until the player is ten blocks from where it began. Stops at three hearts.

minecraft:hotbar_shift.name: Hotbar Shift
minecraft:hotbar_shift.description: The selected hotbar slot changes on its own.

minecraft:book_page.name: Extra Page
minecraft:book_page.description: One creepy page is added to a book and quill or a written book; nothing is erased.

minecraft:shuffle_chest.name: Shuffled Chest
minecraft:shuffle_chest.description: The contents of a nearby chest are shuffled.

minecraft:wear.name: Wear
minecraft:wear.description: A tool loses ten percent durability; it never breaks.

minecraft:rot.name: Rot
minecraft:rot.description: A stack of food in the inventory turns into rotten flesh.

minecraft:tool_look.name: Tool Look
minecraft:tool_look.description: A tool in the inventory looks like another one for a while.

minecraft:armor_off.name: Armor Off
minecraft:armor_off.description: One to four pieces of worn armor come off by themselves and land in the inventory, or on the floor if it is full.

minecraft:vanishing_item.name: Vanishing Item
minecraft:vanishing_item.description: A stack moves from one nearby chest to another.

minecraft:map_marker.name: Map Marker
minecraft:map_marker.description: A red X appears on a filled map and stays there for good.

minecraft:false_compass.name: False Compass
minecraft:false_compass.description: A plain compass points at a spot 30 to 60 blocks away, and keeps doing so.

minecraft:wilted_flowers.name: Wilted Flowers
minecraft:wilted_flowers.description: Potted flowers nearby turn into dead bushes, and are restored after two minutes.

minecraft:withering_crops.name: Withering Crops
minecraft:withering_crops.description: Every grown crop nearby loses one growth stage.

minecraft:turning_frame.name: Turning Frame
minecraft:turning_frame.description: The item in an item frame rotates.

minecraft:new_sign.name: New Sign
minecraft:new_sign.description: A sign's front text becomes a creepy phrase; restored after a minute unless the player edited it.

minecraft:new_painting.name: New Painting
minecraft:new_painting.description: A painting becomes another one of the same size; restored after a minute.

minecraft:glass_wall.name: Glass Wall
minecraft:glass_wall.description: A wall in front of the player turns to glass for four seconds, with a motionless husk standing behind it.

minecraft:dry_cauldron.name: Dry Cauldron
minecraft:dry_cauldron.description: A water cauldron nearby is emptied.

minecraft:dead_ground.name: Dead Ground
minecraft:dead_ground.description: A ragged patch of grass under the player turns to dirt.

minecraft:shifting_floor.name: Shifting Floor
minecraft:shifting_floor.description: The floor under the player briefly turns into another kind of the same material.

minecraft:repaint.name: Repaint
minecraft:repaint.description: Blocks of one kind nearby take on a neighbouring colour, or turn into stripped wood or stone, and change back after a minute.

minecraft:broken_bed.name: Broken Bed
minecraft:broken_bed.description: A nearby bed breaks and drops as an item.

minecraft:wall_hole.name: Wall Hole
minecraft:wall_hole.description: Two blocks of a thin wall vanish for thirty seconds, with no drops.

minecraft:cross.name: Cross
minecraft:cross.description: A plus of bone blocks stands on the ground for a minute.

minecraft:cat_hiss.name: Cat Hiss
minecraft:cat_hiss.description: A nearby cat hisses at nothing.

minecraft:cat_flee.name: Cats Flee
minecraft:cat_flee.description: Cats nearby run away from where the spirit is.

minecraft:dream.name: Dream
minecraft:dream.description: The next time the player wakes, they remember a dream about a spirit near them.

minecraft:dog_barks.name: Dog Barks
minecraft:dog_barks.description: A wolf turns away and barks at nothing.

minecraft:animals_stare.name: Animals Stare
minecraft:animals_stare.description: Animals nearby stop and stare at the player for three seconds.

minecraft:villager_stares.name: Villager Stares
minecraft:villager_stares.description: A villager stops and stares at the player for five seconds.

minecraft:villager_refuses.name: Villager Refuses
minecraft:villager_refuses.description: A villager shakes its head and says no to nobody.

minecraft:bats.name: Bats
minecraft:bats.description: Five bats appear close to the player.

minecraft:open_pen.name: Open Pen
minecraft:open_pen.description: A closed gate beside animals swings open.

minecraft:wild_pet.name: Wild Pet
minecraft:wild_pet.description: A tamed pet loses its owner and turns on the player.

minecraft:copycat.name: Copycat
minecraft:copycat.description: A zombie wearing a copy of the player's armor appears behind them and attacks.

minecraft:cold_breath.name: Cold Breath
minecraft:cold_breath.description: A puff of breath at the player's face, as if in the cold.

minecraft:footprints.name: Footprints
minecraft:footprints.description: On sand or snow, puffs and step sounds appear where the player stood a second ago.

minecraft:local_rain.name: Local Rain
minecraft:local_rain.description: Rain falls over the player alone for six seconds.

minecraft:lost_time.name: Lost Time
minecraft:lost_time.description: At night, the clock jumps a thousand ticks forward for everyone.

minecraft:distant_mob.name: Distant Mob
minecraft:distant_mob.description: A monster sound from anywhere between two and forty blocks away.

minecraft:hostile_animal.name: Hostile Animal
minecraft:hostile_animal.description: A nearby animal groans like a zombie or hisses like a creeper; only the player hears it.

minecraft:approaching_steps.name: Approaching Steps
minecraft:approaching_steps.description: Footsteps close in from some bearing, from far off to near the player.

minecraft:distant_mining.name: Distant Mining
minecraft:distant_mining.description: Under the open sky, rhythmic stone hits and a break sound from below ground.

minecraft:many_breaks.name: Many Breaks
minecraft:many_breaks.description: Six or more glass or stone blocks nearby break one after another. Under hardcore they are gone, with no drops.

minecraft:ladder_steps.name: Ladder Steps
minecraft:ladder_steps.description: Someone climbs a real ladder nearby, or something rises where there is none.

minecraft:spider_overhead.name: Spider Overhead
minecraft:spider_overhead.description: Under a low ceiling, a spider crawls across it right above the player.

minecraft:cracking_floor.name: Cracking Floor
minecraft:cracking_floor.description: The block under the player sounds and looks as if it breaks, and holds.

minecraft:bottle_shatter.name: Bottle Shatter
minecraft:bottle_shatter.description: A splash potion shatters nearby, with no potion.

minecraft:note_block_voice.name: Note Block Voice
minecraft:note_block_voice.description: A note block nearby plays a voice instead of a note.

minecraft:lost_growth.name: Lost Growth
minecraft:lost_growth.description: One crop, stem, berry bush or cocoa pod nearby is back to a seedling.

minecraft:false_windows.name: False Windows
minecraft:false_windows.description: Every window nearby is gone, or fenced, or walled up with what is around it, for this player alone. A click on one, or coming back later, shows the glass.

minecraft:false_looks.name: False Looks
minecraft:false_looks.description: Blocks nearby that one uses look like others of the kind for this player alone: a crafting table like a furnace, a stonecutter like a loom, a chest like an anvil. A click on one shows what it is.

minecraft:ghost_tree.name: Ghost Tree
minecraft:ghost_tree.description: A tree, pale oak, oak or birch, stands where there was none, for this player alone, and they can walk straight through it. Gone after a minute.

minecraft:hallucination.name: Hallucination
minecraft:hallucination.description: A mob stands out in the field facing the player, an iron golem or a villager, that is not there: nothing can touch it. Gone when approached.

minecraft:disguise.name: Disguise
minecraft:disguise.description: An animal nearby looks like another kind to this player alone: a cow like a sheep, a chicken like a wolf.

minecraft:dragon_flyover.name: Dragon Flyover
minecraft:dragon_flyover.description: With a growl, the ender dragon flies over high up, for this player alone.

minecraft:moving_tree.name: Moving Tree
minecraft:moving_tree.description: A tree nearby shifts a few blocks to the side, trunk and crown together, and a half-minute later is back.

minecraft:false_wound.name: False Wound
minecraft:false_wound.description: For a moment the health bar shows four hearts less; the real health is untouched.

minecraft:false_hearts.name: False Hearts
minecraft:false_hearts.description: Wither or poison hearts for five seconds, with no effect.

minecraft:false_hunger.name: False Hunger
minecraft:false_hunger.description: For a moment the hunger bar shows empty.

minecraft:guardian_face.name: Guardian Face
minecraft:guardian_face.description: The elder guardian's face, far from any monument.

minecraft:false_totem.name: False Totem
minecraft:false_totem.description: The totem of undying animation, with no totem.

minecraft:subliminal_title.name: Subliminal Title
minecraft:subliminal_title.description: A title like "BEHIND YOU" for three ticks.

minecraft:red_vignette.name: Red Vignette
minecraft:red_vignette.description: The screen's edges go red, as at the world border, for five seconds.

minecraft:own_voice.name: Own Voice
minecraft:own_voice.description: A chat line in the player's own name that they never wrote, seen only by them.

minecraft:false_death.name: False Death
minecraft:false_death.description: The player's own death message, "slain by ???", seen only by them.

minecraft:private_rain.name: Private Rain
minecraft:private_rain.description: Rain, sometimes a storm, that only this player sees, for twenty seconds.

minecraft:silent_lightning.name: Silent Lightning
minecraft:silent_lightning.description: Lightning strikes nearby and sets nothing on fire.

minecraft:false_night.name: False Night
minecraft:false_night.description: Night falls in the middle of the day, for this player alone, and the sky stops. The real time comes back a moment later.

minecraft:false_slot.name: False Slot
minecraft:false_slot.description: An empty inventory slot shows an item that is not there: a skull, a bone, the player's own head. Any click shows the truth.

minecraft:false_advancement.name: False Advancement
minecraft:false_advancement.description: An advancement toast: "Who are you?", "Not Alone", "Behind You". It is gone from the advancements as soon as it is shown.

minecraft:turned_head.name: Turned Head
minecraft:turned_head.description: A step sounds where the spirit is, and the player's head turns toward it, slowly, by itself.

minecraft:stranger_joins.name: Someone Joins
minecraft:stranger_joins.description: Someone joins the game: the yellow chat line and a name in the player list, which then opens even in single player. They leave a while later.

minecraft:stranger_death.name: Someone Dies
minecraft:stranger_death.description: A death message about another player in chat, in the player's language.

minecraft:lectern_pages.name: Lectern Pages
minecraft:lectern_pages.description: A book on a lectern turns to another page by itself.

minecraft:pot_wobble.name: Pot Wobble
minecraft:pot_wobble.description: A decorated pot wobbles as if something were pushed into it.

minecraft:bell_swing.name: Bell Swing
minecraft:bell_swing.description: A bell swings and rings with nobody near it.

minecraft:redstone_drift.name: Redstone Drift
minecraft:redstone_drift.description: A repeater gets another delay or a comparator the other mode, silently, until it is set back.

minecraft:occupied_bed.name: Occupied Bed
minecraft:occupied_bed.description: A bed reads as occupied for a while, with nobody in it.

minecraft:shuffled_books.name: Shuffled Books
minecraft:shuffled_books.description: The books on a chiseled bookshelf take other slots, until they are put back.

minecraft:dispenser_shot.name: Dispenser Shot
minecraft:dispenser_shot.description: A dispenser clicks, then shoots an arrow at the player.

minecraft:golem_flower.name: Golem Flower
minecraft:golem_flower.description: An iron golem holds out a poppy to empty air.

minecraft:dog_growls.name: Dog Growls
minecraft:dog_growls.description: A tamed dog sits, stares at the empty space beside the player and growls.

minecraft:angry_bees.name: Angry Bees
minecraft:angry_bees.description: The bees of a nearby hive pour out angry at the player.

minecraft:leash_snaps.name: Leash Snaps
minecraft:leash_snaps.description: A leash on a fence post comes loose and the animal runs free.

minecraft:enderman_takes.name: Enderman Takes
minecraft:enderman_takes.description: An enderman nearby picks up a block from the player's build.

minecraft:torch_swap.name: Torch Swap
minecraft:torch_swap.description: A torch or lantern nearby turns into another kind.

minecraft:goat_rams.name: Goat Rams
minecraft:goat_rams.description: A goat nearby charges at the player's position.

minecraft:boat_drifts.name: Boat Drifts
minecraft:boat_drifts.description: An empty boat in the water slides slowly away from the player.

minecraft:minecart_rolls.name: Minecart Rolls
minecraft:minecart_rolls.description: An empty minecart on a rail rolls toward the player.

minecraft:shrieker.name: Shrieker
minecraft:shrieker.description: A sculk shrieker shrieks with nothing near it; nobody is warned.

minecraft:phantom_heartbeat.name: Phantom Heartbeat
minecraft:phantom_heartbeat.description: A warden heartbeat with no warden.

minecraft:insomnia.name: Insomnia
minecraft:insomnia.description: The player is counted as three days without sleep, so phantoms come the next night.

minecraft:infested.name: Infested
minecraft:infested.description: Infested for thirty seconds: silverfish crawl out when the player is hurt.

minecraft:oozing.name: Oozing
minecraft:oozing.description: Oozing for thirty seconds: slimes spill out if the player dies.

minecraft:weaving.name: Weaving
minecraft:weaving.description: Weaving for thirty seconds: cobwebs form if the player dies.

minecraft:drift.name: Drift
minecraft:drift.description: A slow pull in one direction for three seconds, as if by a current.

minecraft:infested_stone.name: Infested Stone
minecraft:infested_stone.description: The stone the player looks at is shown as its infested kind for thirty seconds.

minecraft:ceiling_crack.name: Ceiling Crack
minecraft:ceiling_crack.description: A block overhead cracks as if someone were mining it from above, silently.

minecraft:ice_over.name: Ice Over
minecraft:ice_over.description: Up to 24 source water blocks nearby freeze for thirty seconds.

minecraft:chest_blast.name: Chest Blast
minecraft:chest_blast.description: A chest hisses, then blasts; no blocks break.

minecraft:wrong_smelt.name: Wrong Smelt
minecraft:wrong_smelt.description: The output of a furnace turns into charcoal or rotten flesh, and comes back after two minutes unless taken.

minecraft:doorstep_gift.name: Doorstep Gift
minecraft:doorstep_gift.description: A flower, a bone or raw rabbit lies outside a nearby door.

minecraft:portal_out.name: Portal Out
minecraft:portal_out.description: The nether portal nearby breaks for good, every block of it, with a fizzle; the frame is left standing.

minecraft:block_blink.name: Block Blink
minecraft:block_blink.description: The block the player looks at breaks with its sound and dust, and is back two seconds later.

minecraft:leak.name: Leak
minecraft:leak.description: Water drips from the ceiling overhead for a few seconds; only seen and heard.

minecraft:lava_leak.name: Lava Leak
minecraft:lava_leak.description: Lava drips from the ceiling overhead for a few seconds; only seen and heard.

minecraft:mock_grave.name: Mock Grave
minecraft:mock_grave.description: A gravestone with a sign appears on open ground nearby, bearing the player's name and tomorrow's date.

minecraft:cave_sign.name: Cave Sign
minecraft:cave_sign.description: A sign appears on a wall of the tunnel nearby with a short warning or beckoning; it is taken down after a few minutes.
